Use exactly three characters, with no additional people, no character duplication, and no subtitles or visible text.

[Shot 1] A medium two-shot establishes <Subject 1>. Near the carved railing, <Subject 4> stands closely beside <Subject 2>. They face each other at intimate conversational distance. <Subject 2> smiles softly and rests one hand lightly against his forearm while <Subject 4> gently brushes a loose strand of silver-white hair away from her cheek. They lean slightly closer and whisper affectionately without audible dialogue. The camera performs a slow arc shot with small amplitude around the pair. Their hair, translucent sleeves, and the nearby curtains move naturally in the night breeze while warm lantern light and cool moonlight alternate across their faces.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.700, the camera cuts clearly to a medium shot facing the far end of the corridor. <Subject 3> steps out from behind a translucent curtain and suddenly notices the affectionate pair in the background. She stops immediately. Her expression changes from surprise to restrained, slightly awkward amusement. He turns his head toward <Subject 3>, releases a small confident smile, and raises one hand to stop her from leaving. <Subject 4> (S2), using a relaxed young male voice with a playful and completely sincere delivery, replies: <d>[Chinese] 不，你来的正是时候。</d> He closes his lips after the final word and takes one decisive step toward her.

The camera slowly pulls out as red petals sweep across the foreground. The final frame holds the humorous three-character composition beneath the glowing lanterns, with all faces clearly visible and identities unchanged.
